description: After an answer whose transition carries self_rating {requested: true} (a production answer no judge assessed), ask the LEARNER how well they recalled it — again, hard, good or easy — and pass their rating; never rate for them. It sets the concept's next review (source self_rated) and never changes mastery. One rating per request; scene_id is self_rating.scene_id. Returns the next review date and a line to show.
name: rate_recall
